plan: Drive: from Salmon Arm, about 69 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.17488, -119.31356, pull off on Cp 852 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 3.3 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 257 m, about 92 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-36, Region 3. Season: moose spike fork bulls Sept 20 to Oct 31 (synopsis page 34, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-17, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-17.
G-moose-walk-0052.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 3-36: about 1,060 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.37 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: a long walk from parking. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
